hero.title: Find Your Perfect Space
hero.description: Discover the most beautiful cafes that match your style. From quiet spaces for work to places to meet friends, we help you find the perfect destination.

search.title: Search Your Way
search.initialPrompt: Please use the filters to find cafes.

0.q: How do I find a suitable cafe?
0.a: You can use the search filters above to select area, needs and desired criteria. The system will automatically suggest the most suitable cafes for you.

1.q: Can I save my favorite cafes?
1.a: Yes, simply click the heart icon on each cafe to save to your favorites list. You can view this list in the "Favorites" section.

2.a: We regularly update information from reliable sources and user feedback. If you find incorrect information, please send feedback so we can adjust it.

3.q: Is there a fee to use the service?
3.a: No, all search features and saving favorite cafes are completely free for users.

4.q: Can I suggest a new cafe?
4.a: Yes, you can send new cafe information through the Feedback page. We will review and add to the system if suitable.
